title: config/engines.json
description: Engine policy, read by the launcher and by the server as it starts: which engines may run, which one the launcher starts, and how a run on an alpha or beta engine is acknowledged (docs/design/engine-governance.md). Each engine's version, kind and release channel come from the build, not from this file.

$schema.description: This file's JSON Schema, for editors.

schema_version.description: The layout of this file. A launcher refuses one newer than it reads.

_about.description: What this file is. Not read by any program.

_help.description: Each editable value: what it means, what it accepts, its default. Not read by any program; ./launcher config docs writes it.

selected.title: Engine
selected.description: Engine (Engine). Which engine builds and runs each world. core-legacy is the engine DSTNS has always used; core-ng is its next-generation replacement, built beside it, which gives the same world for the same seed and can also limit worlds to chosen countries or cities. Accepts: "core-legacy" (core-legacy), "core-ng" (core-ng (next generation)). Default: "core-legacy". Applies from the next start of the server (./launcher start). Set to core-ng (next generation) when Where worlds are is set to Countries. Set to core-ng (next generation) when Where worlds are is set to Cities. Set to core-ng (next generation) when Where worlds are is set to One city. Set to core-legacy, it sets Where worlds are to Every city. Set to core-legacy, it sets Places to all.

auto_switch.title: When a run is rejected
auto_switch.description: When a run is rejected (Engine). What the observer offers when a person rejects the risk of an alpha or beta engine: to start the same seed (only the seed) on an enabled stable engine, or only to stop. Accepts: "offer" (Offer a stable engine), "off" (Only stop). Default: "offer". Applies from the next start of the server (./launcher start).

enabled.title: core-ng available
enabled.description: core-ng available (Engine). Off, core-ng stays installed but nothing can start a run on it. Accepts: true or false. Default: true. Applies from the next start of the server (./launcher start).

enforce.title: core-ng: hold runs until acknowledged
enforce.description: core-ng: hold runs until acknowledged (Engine). core-ng is alpha. On, every run on it waits until a person accepts the risk, and the server defers anything that would run it (for applications and the API too). Off removes that protection: runs start at once, and the observer asks nothing. Accepts: true or false. Default: true. Applies from the next start of the server (./launcher start). Set to off, it sets core-ng: acknowledge in the observer to off.

ui.title: core-ng: acknowledge in the observer
ui.description: core-ng: acknowledge in the observer (Engine). On, the observer asks a person to accept or reject. Off while runs are still held, the launcher asks instead: start with --accept-risk. Turning holding off turns this off. Accepts: true or false. Default: true. Applies from the next start of the server (./launcher start). Set to off when core-ng: hold runs until acknowledged is set to off.

channel.description: Release channel: alpha (incomplete; each run held until acknowledged), beta (complete, not yet proven; held), or stable (starts at once). Reported by the build and copied here by the launcher at every start; editing it changes nothing.

version.description: The engine's own version. Reported by the build and copied here by the launcher at every start; editing it changes nothing.

kind.description: real (runs worlds) or pseudo (would only delegate to other engines). Reported by the build and copied here by the launcher at every start; editing it changes nothing.

enabled.title: core-legacy available
enabled.description: core-legacy available (Engine). core-legacy is the default engine, so it cannot be turned off. Accepts: true or false. Default: true. Applies from the next start of the server (./launcher start).
